item.description:
LiveCopilot 2.9.2

中文

改进会话历史保存。磁盘写入失败后可重试，保留随后追加的追问和回答。连续重置同一场会话只生成一条历史。

改进麦克风切换、远程音频采集超时和云端连接关闭后的清理，减少停止或重新开始监听时的状态异常。

减少长会话中的转写刷新和音频回调等待。Intel Mac 上的悬浮窗使用更轻量的背景，降低视频会议期间的合成负担。

改进知识库文本编码处理、大文档分段、本地向量模型回退及翻译服务错误处理。

English

Session history can recover from a failed disk write and retain follow-up questions and answers. Repeated resets archive the session once.

Improved microphone switching and cleanup after system audio capture timeouts or unexpected cloud disconnects.

Reduced transcript refreshes and audio callback contention during long sessions. The overlay uses a lighter background on Intel Macs during video calls.

Improved document decoding, large-document indexing, local embedding fallback, and translation error handling.

LiveCopilot 2.9.1

中文

改善长时间监听时悬浮窗的响应。连续转写和流式回答现在合并刷新，减少长回答反复排版和自动滚动造成的卡顿。

改进停止监听与退出时的资源回收。音频或本地推理任务响应缓慢时，应用会限制等待时间，并隔离上一场会话的延迟回调。

提高本地 BGE-M3 建立知识库索引的稳定性。Intel Mac 默认使用 CPU，GPU 推理失败时可回退到 CPU 重试。长文档的分段和超时处理也已改进。

改进故障诊断。知识库索引出错时可直接前往对应模型设置，诊断报告也能更准确地记录界面卡顿和停止监听时所处的阶段。

English

Improved overlay responsiveness during long listening sessions. Transcript and streaming answer updates are batched to reduce repeated layout and automatic scrolling.

Improved cleanup when stopping or quitting. Audio and local inference tasks have bounded waits, and late callbacks from an earlier session are isolated.

Improved local BGE-M3 indexing. Intel Macs use the CPU by default, GPU inference failures can retry on the CPU, and long documents benefit from safer chunking and revised timeouts.

Improved diagnostics for interface stalls and session shutdown. Indexing errors now link directly to the relevant model settings.

LiveCopilot 2.9.0

中文

六步新手引导帮助你选择输入方式、准备本地模型，并在开始使用前测试回答服务。自定义兼容接口支持配置服务地址和模型 ID。

新增「模式与场景」设置。新手引导、模式设置与实时回答触发页共用 Jev Mode 开关卡片，实时触发页还可查看 Laya 状态和调整灵敏度。

设置页现在明确区分知识库索引模型与回答模型。推荐在本机使用 BGE-M3 检索资料，无需 OpenAI Key。

知识库检索会复用已读取的向量。同一场监听中更换文档后，下一次提问即可使用更新后的资料。

English

Six-step onboarding guides you through audio inputs, local models and testing your answer service. Custom compatible endpoints support a configurable URL and model ID.

Conversation modes and tools now have their own settings page. Jev Mode uses the same switch card across onboarding and settings, with Laya status and sensitivity available under real-time triggers.

Knowledge indexing and answer generation are clearly identified in settings. The recommended local BGE-M3 index runs without an OpenAI API key.

Knowledge retrieval reuses vectors in memory and picks up document changes during an ongoing listening session.
